title: Which records survived the filter?
hook: A toy review either retains every result or keeps only favorable records.

knows: basic arithmetic and how to compare two stated rules
doesNotKnow: how to identify denominator manipulation before treating retained agreement as stronger support

misconception: A higher favorable fraction after selective exclusion means the underlying evidence improved.
objective: Identify denominator manipulation before treating retained agreement as stronger support.
